analysis: Norman fixed direct-effect predictor versus all existing state predictors
boundary: One pooled screen; no inference treating tasks, allocations or capture partitions as independent biological experiments.

evaluation.atomic_scoring: Reuse all27 balanced observation,prediction,conditioning tuples. Score before pattern averaging. Direct effect residual f-Y+b_obs divided by fixed scales. Reuse unchanged state utility arrays.
reporting: all18 depth-state means over tasks and allocations

model.design: 105 constituent-gene multihot inputs; no interactions or intercept
model.objective: sum over training conditions and genes of squared standardized residuals plus alpha times squared standardized coefficient norm
model.prediction: fixed X_test W times original scales, with no evaluation-control input or recentering
model.target: (training condition equal-gemgroup mean minus training ctrl equal-gemgroup mean) divided by the original fixed gene scales

prior_exposure: Additional analysis after the original Norman state-model test results were inspected. The added effect model, hyperparameter grid, selection rule and reporting are fixed before its validation fitting and test evaluation. This is not a blind external validation.

validation.double_membership: Only the original 55 training doubles; rank by SHA256(namespace + NUL + condition), identifier tie-break, assign rank modulo5
validation.each_fold_training: All105 original singles and ctrl plus44 original training doubles
validation.metric: Mean standardized squared error across the55 out-of-fold double-condition predictions and2000 genes, each condition equally weighted
validation.refit: All161 original training conditions after selection
validation.selection_inputs: Training condition means and frozen training-control features/scales only; no test expression, evaluation controls, reference sensitivity or crossing counts
validation.tie_rule: Largest alpha among values within absolute1e-12 of minimum validation MSE
